# AI Text Utility

> Fast, private, browser-based productivity text utilities and AI writing assistants. Processes sensitive data 100% client-side with zero telemetry or remote server storage.

AI Text Utility is a free web suite containing 59 client-side utilities and 110+ curated AI tools directory. All core text operations execute directly in the user's browser using WebAssembly, Web Crypto, and Canvas APIs.

## Core Utilities

- [Word Counter](https://ai-text-utility.vercel.app/tools/word-counter): Real-time word, character, sentence, paragraph, and reading time analyzer.
- [Online Diff Checker](https://ai-text-utility.vercel.app/tools/diff-checker): Visual side-by-side text difference and change comparison.
- [JSON Formatter & Validator](https://ai-text-utility.vercel.app/tools/json-formatter): Format, validate, inspect, and minify JSON data.
- [Regex Tester](https://ai-text-utility.vercel.app/tools/regex-tester): Test regular expressions in real-time with capture groups and catastrophic backtrack protection.
- [Case Converter](https://ai-text-utility.vercel.app/tools/case-converter): Convert text between UPPERCASE, lowercase, Title Case, camelCase, snake_case, and kebab-case.
- [Remove Line Breaks](https://ai-text-utility.vercel.app/tools/remove-line-breaks): Eliminate unwanted line breaks and reformat run-on text into structured paragraphs.
- [Duplicate Line Remover](https://ai-text-utility.vercel.app/tools/remove-duplicate-lines): Deduplicate lists while preserving order.
- [PII & AI Prompt Sanitizer](https://ai-text-utility.vercel.app/tools/pii-sanitizer): Redact and mask sensitive emails, API keys, phone numbers, and credit cards before AI prompting.
- [PDF to Word Converter](https://ai-text-utility.vercel.app/tools/pdf-to-word): In-browser client-side PDF to editable Word document conversion.
- [Word to PDF Converter](https://ai-text-utility.vercel.app/tools/word-to-pdf): In-browser client-side Word to PDF document generation.
- [Image Compressor](https://ai-text-utility.vercel.app/tools/image-compressor): Browser-based client-side image compression to exact file targets (20KB, 50KB, 100KB).
- [Invoice Generator](https://ai-text-utility.vercel.app/tools/invoice-generator): Generate customizable business receipts and PDF invoices in-browser.

## AI Software Directory

- [AI Tools Directory](https://ai-text-utility.vercel.app/ai-tools): Curated catalog of 110+ top AI tools categorized across Writing, Coding, Image, Video, Audio, Productivity, and SEO.

## Privacy & Security

All text processing utilities execute locally in JavaScript/WASM inside the client browser. No user input or documents are stored on or sent to remote servers unless explicitly utilizing AI Rewrite features.
